evidence.quote: for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;

the JFIU will cease accepting STR submissions via STREAMS at 12:00am on 28 January 2026, and will resume accepting STR submissions at 9:00am on 2 February 2026 via STREAMS 2 (hereafter referred to as the “blackout period of STREAMS”);

For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2. The JFIU will provide guidance to facilitate the re-submission.

lost_or_added_conditions: The children narrow the actor from the parent’s general STR context to licensed firms, matching the cited SFC circular but adding a scope condition not explicit in the parent statement.

The contact child restates the blackout with exact intraday boundaries and frames the trigger as each STR requiring urgent submission; the source does not define urgency or establish that contact completes filing.

The history child adds the separate express re-submission obligation for post-implementation submissions through other channels. This is properly bounded and does not assert that blackout contact itself is a submission, but it adds a conditional rule beyond the parent’s original wording.
value.rationale: The decomposition retains the parent’s urgent-blackout contact instruction, its timing qualification, and both unresolved questions. It expressly preserves the distinction between contacting JFIU and completing an STR filing, and it does not convert the later re-submission rule into an automatic consequence of blackout contact. The added licensed-firm scope and separate re-submission rule are identified and bounded, while the unresolved urgency, post-contact procedure, and filing-completion issues remain open.
